notes.title: VHSoverdose RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We're happy to be launching VHSoverdose to the Steam store! We hope you guys enjoy the project and I'm sure a lot of you will be confused about the game's "Far out" world of jamaican dolphins and wireframe ninjas!

HE-HE-HE-HE

Anyway, to continue we're going to be providing Mac/Linux support in the coming days post-release as we've been unable to test on these platforms so far. 

Thanks for purchasing and for those that have been following us during development thanks for supporting us!

Ending this announcement short so I can get some sleep for the first time in 6 months xD!
